resources.string:
This app uses the special WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission, which allows it to modify protected Android system settings. This permission cannot be granted through the regular Android settings - it can be granted using ADB.

The 's source code is open and available on GitHub:
https://github.com/machine7y/GrayForce

The app modifies only one system setting - Simulate color space. This setting controls the display's color mode and allows you to enable or disable the monochrome (grayscale) mode.

The app does not modify any other system settings. You can verify this yourself by reviewing the source code.

There are two ways to install the app:

1. Build the app yourself

Download the source code and Android development tools, build the APK yourself, install it on your phone, and then grant the required permission using ADB.

2. Download the pre-built APK

Download Platform-Tools (ADB) from the official Android website:
https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools

Then download the pre-built APK, install it on your phone, and use ADB from your computer to grant the required permission.

Run the following command:

adb shell pm grant machine7y.grayforce android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS

Before running the command, connect your phone to the computer with USB debugging enabled.

After running the command, the app will have permission to modify the protected system setting required to enable or disable the monochrome display mode.
adb shell pm grant machine7y.grayforce android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
Set a timer to automatically switch to grayscale mode
